entries.source:

「在阿曼加之戰中奮勇作戰。」�

entries.source:

"Killed by a troll at the battle of Armengar."�

特雷爾．丹尼斯
「在阿曼加之戰中死於巨魔之手。」�

entries.source:

"Mother. Lover. Soldier."�

entries.source:

"His victories surpassed his years."�
entries.translation:

「戰功彪炳，遠勝其年歲。」�

entries.source: "The battle of Sar Sargoth was fought here.  Let all who visit this place remember the strength and courage of our ancestors. May their legacy stand forever. "�
entries.translation: 「薩薩戈斯之戰便在此地打響。願造訪此地的人，永遠謹記我們祖先的力量與勇氣。願他們的功業萬古長存。」�

entries.source:
Gorath of the Greenheart Clan
"His death was slow and torturous."�
entries.translation:
綠心氏族的戈拉斯
「死狀淒慘，備受折磨。」�

entries.source:
Owyn Belleforte
"His luck finally ran out."�
entries.translation:
歐文．貝勒佛特
「他的好運終於用盡。」�

entries.source:
Gorath of the Greenheart Clan
"A traitor to his people."�
entries.translation:
綠心氏族的戈拉斯
「背叛了自己族人的叛徒。」�

entries.source:
Gorath of the Greenheart Clan
"He died on his knees."�
entries.translation:
綠心氏族的戈拉斯
「跪地而死。」�

entries.source:
Owyn Belleforte
"Called himself a magician."�
entries.translation:
歐文．貝勒佛特
「自稱是個法師。」�

entries.source:
Gorath of the Greenheart Clan
"Betrayed his people. Choked to death on his own blood."�
entries.translation:
綠心氏族的戈拉斯
「背叛了族人，被自己的血嗆死。」�

entries.source:
Owyn Belleforte
"Merely a pawn in a grand game."�
entries.translation:
歐文．貝勒佛特
「不過是一盤大局裡的棋子。」�

entries.source:
Gorath of the Greenheart Clan
"Delekhan ran him through."�
entries.translation:

「被迪勒肯一劍刺穿。」�

entries.source:
Gorath of the Greenheart Clan
"His human blood made him weak."�
entries.translation:
綠心氏族的戈拉斯
「人類的血脈使他變得軟弱。」�

entries.source:
Gorath of the Greenheart Clan
"Lay with beasts."�
entries.translation:
綠心氏族的戈拉斯
「與禽獸為伍。」�

entries.source:
@3 gasped.
	Looking from one headstone to the next, he was horrified that each bore either his or @5's names...�
entries.translation:
@3倒抽了一口氣。
	他望向一塊又一塊的墓碑，驚恐地發現每一塊上頭刻的不是他自己的名字，就是@5的…�

entries.source: How can they have made these stones so quickly?�
entries.translation: 他們怎麼可能這麼快就刻好這些石碑？�

entries.source: They are possessed of an evil magic, these stones. They are known as the Terror Stones. Condemned of Sar-Sargoth are sometimes on the eve of their execution brought to this place and interred so that their head remains above ground. Until the time they are to die, they gaze onto their names and often go mad. I can only assume Delekhan intended that we were to be brought here...�
entries.translation: 這些石碑帶著邪惡的魔法。它們被稱為「恐懼之石」。薩薩戈斯的死囚，有時會在行刑前夕被帶到這裡，活埋在地下，只留頭顱露出地面。在死期到來之前，他們只能凝視著自己的名字，往往因此發瘋。我只能猜想，迪勒肯本來就打算把我們帶到這裡來…�

entries.source: After people are executed, are they buried here?�
entries.translation: 人被處決之後，就埋葬在這裡嗎？�

entries.source: We are like unto the Eledhel in our ways of the dead. Once a moredhel falls in death, that which lies upon the ground is a living thing no more, only rotting meat, unworthy of further attention. Only when we intend great insult do we inter our kin.�
entries.translation: 在喪葬習俗上，我們跟伊列德人相近。莫瑞德人一旦死去，倒在地上的就不再是活物，只是一具腐肉，不值得再多加理會。唯有存心羞辱時，我們才會埋葬自己的族人。�

entries.source: Before us lies Harlech. We will have to turn to the east and skirt along the mountains...�
entries.translation: 前方就是哈勒克。我們得轉向東方，沿著山脈繞行…�

entries.source: Why? We could probably do with picking up a few supplies. Surely we can get through if we just duck in and back out...�
entries.translation: 為什麼？我們說不定正好需要補給一下。只是溜進去再溜出來，應該沒問題吧…�

entries.source: It is not that simple. Among my kin, my appearance is...well known.�
entries.translation: 事情沒那麼簡單。在我的族人之間，我的長相…相當有名。�

entries.source: Why? Are you a prince or something?�
entries.translation: 為什麼？難不成你是王子之類的人物？�

entries.source: Aside from Delekhan, there is only one other moredhel of high station other than myself. I suspect him long dead, slain by Moraeulf when I fled the Northlands and encountered your Seigneur Locklear...�
entries.translation: 除了迪勒肯之外，地位比我高的莫瑞德人只剩一個。我猜他早就死了，在我逃離北地、遇見你們的洛克利爾紳爵那時候，就已經被莫萊伍夫殺了…�

entries.source: But if you're so important, then surely we can find óhelp!�
entries.translation: 可是如果你真的這麼重要，我們一定能找到ó人幫忙的！�

entries.source:
No...all claims I may have once had were sundered when first I left the Northlands. I have unresolvable differences with most of my kindred.
	This is not the time to be discussing such things. We ómust turn to the east. Be careful of how you walk here, Owyn.�
entries.translation:
不…我當年剛離開北地時，就已經斷絕了所有可能的名分。我跟大多數族人之間，有著解不開的心結。
	現在不是討論這些的時候。我們ó必須轉向東方。歐文，走路小心點。�

entries.source: We haven't moved far enough away from Harlech. We should skirt the mountains to the far east to travel around it.�
entries.translation: 我們離哈勒克還不夠遠。我們該沿著山脈繞到更東邊，才能繞過它。�

entries.source: If my nose does not mislead, we must be nearing the naphtha caves of which Irmelyn spoke. It will be critical for you to cooperate with all that I say if we are to get Obkhar out of these caves alive.�
entries.translation: 如果我的鼻子沒騙我，我們一定是快到伊爾梅琳提過的那個瀝青洞穴了。要想把奧布卡活著救出這些洞穴，你必須完全配合我接下來說的每一句話。�

entries.source: Why are we even doing this? Why don't we simply ñhead ñsouthð?�
entries.translation: 這件事我們何必淌這渾水？我們怎麼不ñ乾脆ñ直接往南走ð呢？�

entries.source: Obkhar is a name familiar to me and I believe he may serve a purpose with his freedom. Kin to me in irritation, he has pricked Delekhan's ire times enough that we may ódepend he will avenge himself upon his captor.�
entries.translation: 奧布卡這名字我很熟悉，我相信放他自由對我們會有用處。他跟我一樣，是個讓人頭疼的傢伙，惹惱迪勒肯的次數多到我們大可ó指望他會找上他的俘虜者報仇。�

entries.source: You're hoping that he's as much a bother to Delekhan as Narab then... So what will we need to do?�
entries.translation: 這麼說，你是希望他能像納拉布一樣讓迪勒肯頭疼…那我們該怎麼做？�

entries.source: Venutrier of Lan operates in this locale and is known as a trader of slaves. I will offer you into slavery...�
entries.translation: 蘭恩的維努特里爾在這一帶做買賣，人稱奴隸販子。我打算把你賣給他當奴隸…�

entries.source: You're going to ñwhatð?!�
entries.translation: 你是要ñ做什麼ð？！�

entries.source: Do not alarm yourself overmuch. Venutrier would have no need of a scrawny young boy in his naphtha caves and will undoubtedly insist óI see his operations---reassurance you will not be ill treated---and when we have entered the caves, undoubtedly the both of us will be taken captive.�
entries.translation: 別太驚慌。維努特里爾在他的瀝青洞穴裡用不上一個瘦弱的男孩，他一定會堅持要ó我親眼見識他的生意——這樣才能保證你不會受到虐待——等我們進了洞穴之後，我們兩個十之八九都會被抓去當俘虜。�

entries.source: This is your brilliant plan? We just got away from Delekhan in Sar-Sargoth and you want to get us taken captive again?�
entries.translation: 這就是你的絕妙計畫？我們才剛從薩薩戈斯甩開迪勒肯，你又想讓我們被抓去當俘虜？�

entries.source: We have a way out, however. As you may detect by the stench of this river that runs hard by, the naphtha mixes with it from and underground river which runs through the caves---it has since the day Guy du Bas-Tyra torched Armengar. I know this because I have had words with others once held captive by Venutrier. Once we are ready to leave, we dive in the underground river and will emerge somewhere downstream.�
entries.translation: 不過我們有脫身的辦法。你應該聞得出附近這條河散發的臭味——洞穴裡有條地下河，瀝青會滲進河水裡，自從居伊．杜．巴斯泰拉燒了阿曼加那天起就是如此。我是聽其他曾被維努特里爾囚禁過的人提起才知道的。等我們準備離開時，就跳進那條地下河，順流而下，總會在下游某處冒出來。�

entries.source: No one has ever died doing this?�
entries.translation: 從來沒有人這樣死掉過嗎？�

entries.source: I have met none that have. Come, we have business to attend to.�
entries.translation: 我還沒遇過。走吧，我們還有正事要辦。�
